200.body: Polish NGOs urge PM’s “right-hand man” to withdraw constitutional court candidacy Aug 21, 2026 | Law , Politics Keep our news free from ads and paywalls by making a donation to support our work! A group of Polish civil society organisations has urged a former government minister to withdraw his candidacy to become a Constitutional Tribunal (TK) judge, saying his close ties to the prime minister could undermine confidence in the court’s independence. Przeczytajcie nasz apel, link w komentarzu ⬇️ pic.twitter.com/LPlbk39lNr — Helsińska Fundacja Praw Człowieka (@hfhrpl) August 20, 2026 The appeal follows Prime Minister Donald Tusk’s announcement that Maciej Berek, who until recently served as a government minister and whom Tusk has described as his “right-hand man”, would be put forward as a candidate for the Constitutional Tribunal.
